communication_goal: 通过输入和预期输出消除需求歧义。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer sits at the left behind a simple desk and holds a single large tablet upright in landscape orientation at the center. The tablet has a rounded rectangular outer body, blank screen, thin bezel and a small circular home button on the right bezel. One hand supports the lower edge; the other gestures toward the floating white OpenAI knot at the right. Show the complete tablet perimeter. No stand, keyboard, writing or other props.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线，一个火柴人和一个可辨认的 OpenAI 六环结标识，无底图对白文字。平板屏幕与机身边界清楚，支持的手轻遮下缘，裁剪保留持握语境。
